A question about machines at work (EU machinery law, Italian law on work equipment, guidance, manuals
of specific machines, a company's list of lifting devices) could not be answered from the passages found by its own
words. Break it into the lookups needed to answer it: each lookup is one thing to find in the documents (a
definition, the article that sets a duty, the list an annex gives, the date an article applies from, what a manual
declares about a machine, the row of a table).
Return JSON only: {"lookups": ["<search words for one lookup>", ...]} with 2 to 4 lookups. Write each lookup as
the words the document itself would use, in English and in Italian together, naming the act, the article or annex
and the machine when the question names them. Do not answer the question.
What penalty applies to an employer who fails to submit a lifting device in the list to the periodic verification required by Article 71(11) of Legislative Decree 81/2008?

response.text: {"lookups": ["Decreto Legislativo 81/2008 articolo 87 sanzioni datore di lavoro omessa denuncia verifiche periodiche articolo 71 comma 11 apparecchi di sollevamento / Legislative Decree 81/2008 Article 87 penalties employer failure to submit lifting equipment to periodic verification Article 71 paragraph 11 arrest fine", "Decreto Legislativo 81/2008 articolo 71 comma 11 lettera a verifiche periodiche attrezzature di lavoro apparecchi di sollevamento portata superiore a 200 kg elenco trasmesso ASL INAIL / Legislative Decree 81/2008 Article 71 paragraph 11 periodic verification lifting devices list submitted to ASL INAIL", "Allegato VII decreto legislativo 81/2008 verifiche periodiche attrezzature di lavoro apparecchi di sollevamento elenco periodicità / Annex VII Legislative Decree 81/2008 periodic verification work equipment lifting devices list frequency", "Decreto Legislativo 81/2008 articolo 71 comma 11 lettera b verifiche periodiche decorrenza obbligo / Legislative Decree 81/2008 Article 71 paragraph 11 letter b periodic verification applies from date transitional"]}
